title: Velocity Controller
text: Discrete-time velocity controller, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Control type} sets Control model PI; {Controller proportional gain} sets the proportional gain, {Controller integral gain} sets the integral gain, {P controller proportional gain} sets the p proportional gain, {Integral anti-windup gain} sets the pI anti-windup gain, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time, {Discretization sample time} sets the sample time for discretization and {Enable zero cancellation} sets the feedforward zero-cancellation. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Control type
params.values: Control model PI control (default) | P control | P-PI control

params.name: Discretization sample time
params.values: Sample time for discretization 0.001 (default) | positive scalar
